learnings: Cooperative `super()` with `**kwargs` lets every class in the MRO initialise exactly once.
Mixins add capabilities; put them before the concrete base class.
Overrides can extend the parent result by calling `super().method()`.
pitfalls: Forgetting `super().__init__(**kwargs)` in one class silently breaks the chain for everything after it.
